en-US.title: Eve Driver
en-US.subtitle: Go online and send fare offers
en-US.description:
Eve Driver is the companion app for independent drivers on the Eve marketplace. Go online, receive nearby ride requests, send a fare offer, and complete pickup through drop-off. Eve records suggested and matched fares for audit. It does not collect ride payments or take commission.

KEY FEATURES:
• Driver onboarding with vehicle and document upload
• Go online and see nearby requests
• Send one offer at a time and manage the trip lifecycle
• Earnings history for completed trips

LOCATION
Eve uses your location while the app is in use so we can send nearby offers and share progress with the rider during a trip. Background location is not required.

DOCUMENTS
You can upload licence, insurance, and vehicle files from your device during onboarding.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial App Store release of Eve Driver.

review.notes: Eve Driver is a marketplace app for independent drivers. Provide an approved staging driver account. Allow location when prompted. Document upload uses the system file picker. Payment is off-platform. Privacy Policy and Terms are in the app under Legal.
